nomenclature_assessment.interpretation: The formal new-combination entry explicitly lists Candida glabrata as a synonym; this resolves names, not resistance or an experimental strain.
nomenclature_assessment.location: Section III, formal nomenclatural entry 3 and its continued synonym list
nomenclature_assessment.redistribution: Native PDF retained only in ignored research cache; public output paraphrases the nomenclatural finding with citation.

puccinia_partial_primary_context.endpoint: ED50, not MIC; no values converted or clinical category inferred
puccinia_partial_primary_context.finding: The abstract reports limited impact of the assessed genetic change, a moderate expression/sensitivity association, and retained in-vivo control. These are distinct observations, not proof that every CYP51 entry confers resistance.
puccinia_partial_primary_context.limitations: Indexed reading and identifier concordance are not native full-text, figure or supplement review; the paper is not equated with the UniProt submission citation.
locations: Analysis of the cyp51 gene sequence

review_findings.disposition: Excluded hybrid, virus and otherNames-only matches; the latter required a separate primary nomenclatural assessment.
Only native results count. Suggested searches with altered taxonomy IDs were not followed.
The unreviewed singleton is a reference candidate, not a verified canonical protein or resistant allele.
The submission title and related publisher abstract do not establish a causal resistant allele; inspect full primary results, figures and source-row context before replacing the CARD claim.
CYP51B identity does not resolve ARO:3009486's voriconazole-label versus tebuconazole-edge discrepancy.
